Pianist and composer Chuck Lamb has enjoyed a diverse career as a leader of a jazz fusion group, and as an accompanist to numerous jazz soloists. He is currently a member of the Brubeck Brothers Quartet and hosts monthly jazz events at the venerable Caffe Lena in Saratoga, NY.
Chuck was interviewed in Clinton, NY on February 7, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
